summary: Temporary danger area EGD494B near Stockton-on-Tees for drone operations, up to 600 feet above sea level, 1.61 nautical miles radius.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD494B INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
543357N 0011839W (STOCKTON-ON-TEES). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH
LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR
APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT
RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER
CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE
EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. DEC 24-JAN 03 CONTACT
DRONES(AT)CLEVELAND.POLICE.UK. AR-2026-187/18.
